versions.text: Criterion: Verify that no safety hazards are created by the jettisoning of an aerial refueling hose, or a portion of the hose. Standard: No safety hazards are created by the jettisoning of an aerial refueling hose, or a portion of the hose. Conditions to be considered include, but are not limited to: the hose or any sprayed fuel contacts the air vehicle, and fuel leakage within the store/pod (see 8.4, this document, for evaluation of fire hazards). Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, inspection and review of documentation. Analysis, ground/flight test and inspection indicate that no safety hazards are created by the jettisoning of an aerial refueling hose, or a portion of the hose (see 8.4, this document, for evaluation of fire hazards). References: JSSG-2009: G.3.4.7.2, G.4.4.7.2; G.3.4.7.3, G.4.4.7.3 MIL-HDBK-516: 8.4
